en.text: We didn't expect to win.

original: 僕に勝たせてよ。

en.text: Let me win.

original: 勝って当たり前だったあの選手も寄る年波には勝てない。

en.text: Even those players who saw winning as a given can't triumph over getting old.

original: 勝つためにここにいる。

en.text: We're here to win.

original: 6対2で勝ったよ。

en.text: We won six to two.

original: 誰も僕らが勝つとは思ってないよ。

en.text: Nobody's expecting us to win.
No one thinks we'll win.
No one expects us to win.

original: 誰が勝ったと思う？

en.text: Guess who won.
Who do you think won?

original: 誰が勝ったか、当ててみ。

en.text: Guess who won.

original: 真理愛が勝つよ。

en.text: Maria will win.

original: 私達は、試合には勝つと確信していた。

en.text: We were certain of winning the game.
We were confident that we would win the game.

original: どうしてトムが勝つって思うの？

en.text: What makes you think Tom will win?

original: 勝つってわかってたし。

en.text: I knew we'd win.
I knew I was going to win.
I knew I'd win.
I knew we were going to win.

original: トムはメアリーに勝ってほしかったんだ。

en.text: Tom wanted Mary to win.

original: トムに勝ってほしくなかったんだ。

en.text: I didn't want Tom to win.

original: 勝てば天国、負ければ即死。

en.text: If you win you'll be in heaven, if you lose it's certain death.

original: 大変だけど、勝つぞ！

en.text: It'll be hard, but we're going to win!

original: 僕たちなら勝てる。必ず勝ちます。

en.text: We can win if it's us. We will win.
